entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It doesn't work.
I'm sorry to hear there's a problem with your VeloBand Pulse. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a technical fault. The thing is complete garbage.
Okay, I see. I can definitely look into that for you. When you say it's not working, is it not turning on, or is it having trouble syncing with the app?
Look, I don't have time to go through a whole list of questions. I tried it, it doesn't work, and I want a refund.

I understand you'd like a quick resolution. To process a return for a defect, our first step is to troubleshoot the issue or have our technical team verify the fault. I can transfer you to them right now, it should only take a few minutes.
No. I'm not doing that. You guys just want money and sell products that don't work. I'm not wasting another minute on this. Just give me my money back.

I understand your frustration, but I do need to explain our policy. Without verifying a technical fault, the request is treated as a standard return. I see here that your VeloBand Pulse was delivered 16 days ago. Due to the way the Pulse hardware activates and links to a user's account, it has a strict 10-day return window.
So you're saying you can't do anything. Fine. Of course.

Because we're outside the 10-day window and we can't confirm a device malfunction, I am unable to authorize a refund. I know this isn't the answer you were hoping for. One option many of our customers use is our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace to sell the device to another user.
Whatever. Thanks for nothing, I guess.
I am sorry we couldn't come to a different resolution today. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
